summary: Iteration 10 — DutyConnect Phase C (referral & ambassador MVP) frontend-only verification on mobile viewport 390x844 as admin delivered+t1@resend.dev. ALL in-scope checks PASS. (1) Account tab shows both account-referrals-row ('Refer a friend' · 'Free Pro months') and account-admin-referrals-row ('Referral admin' · 'Approve rewards'). (2) /referrals: referral-code is 'MDJAY3Q3' (exactly 8 chars from ALPHABET 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789'); referral-share-button visible; empty state 'referrals-empty' is rendered when the account has no referrals; applying an invalid code 'ZZZZZZZZ' triggers 400 /api/referrals/apply and the error toast reads 'That referral code isn't valid.' (matches referrals.py ERRORS.invalid_code). (3) End-to-end admin approve/cancel: seeded two awaiting_approval referrals via /app/test_reports/seed_phase_c.py (two friends delivered+phasec_friend{a,b}, qualifies_at in the past, with a non-voided subscription whose expiry >= first_paid_at+30d so the server-side re-check in approve passes). On /admin-referrals 'To approve' both cards appeared; tapping admin-approve-<id> (window.confirm auto-accepted) produced toast 'Approved – rewards added' and removed the card. tapping admin-cancel-<id2> produced 'Referral cancelled' and removed the card. Switching to 'All' filter shows one 'Rewarded' card and one cancelled card ('Not eligible · Reason: Cancelled by admin' per REFERRAL_STATUS mapping, equivalent to Cancelled). (4) Member lookup: admin-member-email with delivered+t1@resend.dev + admin-member-find displays admin-member-card 'Code MDJAY3Q3 · Member · limit 3 rewards/month' (default cap); admin-member-ambassador toggle flips to 'Ambassador · limit 10'; admin-member-cap=5 + admin-member-cap-save → 'limit 5'; clearing + save → 'limit 10' (reset to ambassador default via clear_cap:true); un-toggle returns to Member/limit 3. (5) /register (after signout) renders register-referral-input (count=1, visible) with placeholder 'e.g. 7KQ2MXRP' and hint about mutual free month. (6) /upgrade: hero shows UPGRADE; Monthly chip reads 'Monthly · £3.99'; Annual chip reads 'Annual · £34.99'; subscribe button reads 'Subscribe – £24.99 per year' because this account is founding_eligible (hero note: 'Founding member price: £24.99 for the first 12 months, then £34.99 per year'), consistent with BILLING_MODE=mock reference prices. upgrade-unavailable-note is present (web preview can't use Google Play billing). (7) Regression smoke on /shift-form: shift-type chips Standard, Overtime, Extra, Other, Bed Watch, Constant Watch, PP all render for this user. No React Native red screens. Remaining console noise is pre-existing warnings ('shadow* style props are deprecated', 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated'); a /api/billing/entitlement 401 flashes briefly on logout and a 400 is expected for the invalid referral code apply.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin referral code remains MDJAY3Q3 on delivered+t1@resend.dev. Welcome screen still needs an extra tap on 'Sign in' before the login form renders. The approve/cancel flow uses window.confirm on web — Playwright must inject `window.confirm = () => true` before login or the modal blocks the tap. The 'Cancelled' admin card renders as 'Not eligible · Reason: Cancelled by admin' because REFERRAL_STATUS maps 'cancelled' that way; this is the intended UI copy, not a bug. /add-shift returns Unmatched Route — the Add Shift route is /shift-form (home-hero-add-shift-button and home-quick-add-shift both router.push to /shift-form). Backend has a token_hash unique index on subscriptions — any manual seed of a sub must set token_hash to a unique value (used uuid4().hex). After any UI test as this account, re-run `python /app/test_reports/seed_phase_c.py cleanup` to $unset ambassador/referral_cap/sync_device.
